name: Programming in C
topics: Computer Fundamentals: Hardware, Memory, CPU, OS
Explain the ALU and registers; differentiate main, secondary and cache memory and volatile vs non-volatile memory.
What is an operating system? Write notes on batch, multiprogramming and time-sharing systems; convert the given storage units.
Compilers, Interpreters, Algorithms and Flowcharts
Differentiate compiler, interpreter and assembler with examples.
Write an algorithm and draw a flowchart to solve a quadratic equation / find the sum of digits of a number.
Data Types, Operators, Expressions and Type Casting
Explain the data types in C and implicit vs explicit type casting with examples, including loss of precision.
Evaluate the given expression showing operator precedence; explain logical, relational and ternary operators with examples.
Output Prediction (Code Tracing)
Find the output of the given C program with increment/decrement and logical operators, showing the execution steps.
Find the output of the given program using pointers / switch / loops and explain why.
Control Statements: if-else, switch, Loops, break/continue
Write a calculator program using a switch statement for the four basic operations.
Differentiate break and continue, and while and do-while loops, with examples; write a program to check a leap year.
Arrays and Matrices
Write a program for matrix addition/multiplication or to find the largest and smallest element in a 3×3 matrix.
Write a program to print the transpose of a matrix and the sum of its elements; can an array be passed to a function?
Strings and String Functions
Write a program to concatenate/compare two strings or find string length without library functions.
Explain strcpy(), strrev(), strcat() and strlen() with examples; explain getchar() and putchar().
Functions, Recursion and Parameter Passing
Differentiate call by value and call by reference with examples.
Explain recursion (tail and non-tail) and reverse an array recursively; compare recursion with loops.
Pointers and Dynamic Memory
Write a program to swap two numbers using pointers; explain array of pointers and pointer to array.
Explain malloc(), realloc() and free(); what goes wrong if you free a pointer that was not dynamically allocated?
Structures, Unions and Storage Classes
Differentiate structures and unions; write a program to store and print records of students/patients using an array of structures.
Explain the storage classes in C with examples; what is designated initialization of a structure?
Pre-processor Directives and File Handling
What are preprocessor directives? Explain #define and #include<> vs #include"".
Write a program to read student records from a file into an array of structures and write them to a new file with error handling.
Problem-Solving Programs
Write a program to print prime numbers in a range, a given pattern, or the sum of the first and last digits of a number.
Write a program to convert decimal to octal, or to print even numbers using a while loop.
